title: RCMP investigate after in-custody death
article: ABBOTSFORD (NEWS1130) - Homicide investigators have been called in after a man died in Abbotsford Police custody over the weekend.
RCMP Sergeant Peter Thiessen says someone reported a prowler on Rosewood Drive early Friday morning, soonafter officers found 37-year-old Christopher Kampman.
"He was subsequently arrested and transported to a local area hospital in fairly serious condition where he subsequently died [in the] early morning of Sunday, July 3rd."
Thiessen adds police have dealt with Kampman before but he can't say yet how he died.
Anyone with information about this case or Kampman's whereabouts or activities in the early morning hours on Friday should call the IHIT Tip Line at 1.877.551.IHIT (4448).
